_comment: Local corrections applied by tools/build_catalog.py on top of the upstream sources. Edit freely, then rebuild the catalog and run `python -m godex.cli catalog-load`.
_untargeted: Forms that exist in the game data but cannot be caught or kept (battle-only or internal). They stay in the catalog but do not count towards completion.
_species: Per-species flag overrides keyed by National Dex number: released, shiny, shadow, gmax, dynamax.
_forms: Per-form flag overrides keyed by form id: released, shiny, shadow, name, kind.
_missing_species: Species the sources don't fully describe yet (e.g. in the game files but not released). Added as unreleased unless 'released' is set.
